    USING "ITALY_WEEKLY_FUEL_PRICES" AS "ITALY_WEEKLY_FUEL_PRICES"

            "MONTH_NUM_OF_YEAR") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("IT_MONTH_NUM_OF_YEAR_HIER" AS "MONTH_NUM_OF_YEAR" DEFAULT),
      "IT_MONTH_OF_YEAR_AD" AS "IT_MONTH_OF_YEAR_AD"
        KEY ("MONTH_OF_YEAR")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT ("MONTH_OF_YEAR") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("IT_MONTH_OF_YEAR_HIER" AS "MONTH_OF_YEAR" DEFAULT),
      "IT_PRICE_COMPONENT_AD" AS "IT_PRICE_COMPONENT_AD"
        KEY ("PRICE_COMPONENT")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT (
            "PRICE_COMPONENT") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("IT_PRICE_COMPONENT_HIER" AS "PRICE_COMPONENT" DEFAULT),
      "IT_PRODUCT_AD" AS "IT_PRODUCT_AD"
        KEY ("PRODUCT_NAME")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT ("PRODUCT_NAME") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("IT_PRODUCT_HIER" AS "PRODUCT" DEFAULT),
      "IT_TIME_AD" AS "IT_TIME_AD"

          REFERENCES DISTINCT ("SURVEY_DATE") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("IT_TIME_HIER" AS "TIME" DEFAULT))

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE EDITIONABLE ANALYTIC VIEW "AV_AI"."NYS_SPENDING_AV"
    CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'New York State Spending'
    CLASSIFICATION "DESCRIPTION" VALUE 'New York State Spending'
    CLASSIFICATION "DATA_SOURCE_URL"
      VALUE 'https://openbudget.ny.gov/spendingForm.html'
    USING "NYS_SPENDING_T" AS "NYS_SPENDING_T"
    DIMENSION BY (
      "NYS_FP_CATEGORY_AD" AS "NYS_FP_CATEGORY_AD"
        KEY ("FINANCIAL_PLAN_CATEGORY")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT (
            "FINANCIAL_PLAN_CATEGORY") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("NYS_FP_CATEGORY_HIER" AS "FINANCIAL_PLAN" DEFAULT),
      "NYS_FUNCTION_AD" AS "NYS_FUNCTION_AD"
        KEY ("AGENCY")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT ("AGENCY") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("NYS_FUNCTION_HIER" AS "FUNCTION" DEFAULT),
      "NYS_FUND_AD" AS "NYS_FUND_AD"
        KEY ("SUBFUND")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT ("SUBFUND") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("NYS_FUND_HIER" AS "FUND" DEFAULT),
      "NYS_YEAR_AD" AS "NYS_YEAR_AD"
        KEY ("YEAR")
          REFERENCES DISTINCT ("YEAR") SPARSE MANY TO ONE RELATIONSHIP
        HIERARCHIES ("NYS_YEAR_HIER" AS "YEAR" DEFAULT))
    MEASURES (
      "CPI" FACT (
        cpi)
        AGGREGATE BY MAX
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'CPI',
      "DOLLARS" FACT (
        dollars * 1000)
        AGGREGATE BY SUM
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Dollars',
      "CPI_ADJUSTED_DOLLARS" AS (
        CASE WHEN cpi = 0 OR QUALIFY(cpi, year = HIER_LAST(HIER_LEVEL_MEMBERS(CURRENT MEMBER WITHIN LEVEL))) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE dollars * ((QUALIFY(cpi, year = HIER_LAST(HIER_LEVEL_MEMBERS(CURRENT MEMBER WITHIN LEVEL)))) / cpi) END)
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Inflation Adjusted Dollars',
      "DOLLARS_YA" AS (
        LAG(dollars) OVER (HIERARCHY year OFFSET 1 WITHIN LEVEL))
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Dollars Year Ago',
      "DOLLARS_CHG_YA" AS (
        LAG_DIFF(dollars) OVER (HIERARCHY year OFFSET 1 WITHIN LEVEL))
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Dollars Change Year Ago',
      "DOLLARS_PCT_CHG_YA" AS (
        LAG_DIFF_PERCENT(dollars) OVER (HIERARCHY year OFFSET 1 WITHIN LEVEL))
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Dollars % Change Year Ago',
      "FUNCTION_SHR_PARENT" AS (
        CASE WHEN QUALIFY(dollars, function = HIER_PARENT(CURRENT MEMBER)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE dollars / QUALIFY(dollars, function = HIER_PARENT(CURRENT MEMBER)) END)
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Function Percentage',
      "FIN_PLAN_SHR_PARENT" AS (
        SHARE_OF(dollars HIERARCHY financial_plan PARENT))
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Financial Plan Percentage',
      "FUND_SHR_PARENT" AS (
        SHARE_OF(dollars HIERARCHY fund PARENT))
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Fund Percentage',
      "DOLLARS_INDEX_TO_FIRST_YEAR" AS (
        CASE WHEN QUALIFY(dollars, year = HIER_FIRST(HIER_LEVEL_MEMBERS(CURRENT MEMBER WITHIN LEVEL))) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(dollars / (QUALIFY(dollars, year = HIER_FIRST(HIER_LEVEL_MEMBERS(CURRENT MEMBER WITHIN LEVEL)))),2) END)
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION" VALUE 'Dollars Indexed to First Year',
      "DOLLARS_INDEX_TO_FIRST_YEAR_CPI_ADJUSTED" AS (
        CASE WHEN QUALIFY(cpi_adjusted_dollars, year = HIER_FIRST(HIER_LEVEL_MEMBERS(CURRENT MEMBER WITHIN LEVEL))) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(cpi_adjusted_dollars / (QUALIFY(cpi_adjusted_dollars, year = HIER_FIRST(HIER_LEVEL_MEMBERS(CURRENT MEMBER WITHIN LEVEL)))),2) END)
        CLASSIFICATION "CAPTION"
          VALUE 'Dollars Indexed to First Year - Inflation Adjusted')
    DEFAULT MEASURE "CPI"
    DEFAULT AGGREGATE BY SUM
    CACHE USING ENFORCED CONSTRAINTS
